title: Dolly Parton’s New Kendra Scott Jewelry Line Pulls Inspo From ‘Coat of Many Colors’ – Shop the Collection Here
summary: The Dolly Parton x Kendra Scott collection was released on Wednesday, April 22, and features a ton of colorful patchwork options.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Dolly Parton has a full-blown empire, encompassing everything from baked goods , cookbooks , cookware , wine , makeup and fragrances .

The “9 to 5” singer is adding even more jewelry to her lengthy list of endeavors with another music-inspired collaboration with Kendra Scott. The country music icon’s latest collection of wears dropped Wednesday, April 22, on the jewelry brand’s website . Pieces range in price from $90 to $250. The line is inspired by Parton’s 1971 hit “Coat of Many Colors,” a song which peaked at No. 4 on Billboard ‘s Hot Country Songs chart. The new collection features a bracelet along with studs and vintage-inspired necklaces, all featuring a patchwork-themed motif somewhere.

Some of our favorites from the line include the Patchwork Vintage Gold Strand Necklace from $198 with a quilted-inspired design and a vintage-inspired look that makes the jewelry look well-loved. The piece is dotted with colorful gemstones surrounded by gold hardware, a mishmash of color that stays on that patchwork theme. The necklace is short enough that it can be utilized as a layering piece worn with some of your other favorite necklaces.

The Patchwork Vintage Gold Statement Bracelet for $250 is another favorite, looking like a really cool piece you’d find at an antique store, looking for treasures. As the name suggests, this one’s for the maximalists because of its usage of color. It’s a rather chunky item with patchwork-inspired hardware that connects each colorful gemstone in a manner that looks rather random, but intentionally so.

Dolly Parton’s first Kendra Scott collection was inspired by her 1974 song “Love Is Like a Butterfly” and featured pieces with butterfly motifs. These included dazzling rings, necklaces and earrings. “Love is Like a Butterfly” spent a week at No. 1 on the Hot Country Songs chart. Keep reading to shop our favorites from Parton’s patchwork-inspired collection with Kendra Scott below.

Shop the Dolly Parton x Kendra Scott’s Latest Collection Below

Dolly Parton x Kendra Scott Patchwork Vintage Gold Strand Necklace

$198

Buy Now at kendra Scott

This is a vintage-inspired necklace with a colorful patchwork finish. This style is perfect for layering because it sits closer to the neck.

Dolly Parton x Kendra Scott Patchwork Vintage Gold Statement Bracelet

$250

This patchwork-inspired bracelet reminds us of something we’d get at a really trendy vintage store. The piece features multiple colorful motifs and a thick band.

Dolly Parton x Kendra Scott Patchwork Ari Heart Gold Stud Earrings

$90

Studs are a must-have for any jewelry lover because they’re simple but make you look instantly put together. These are gold hearts with an iridescent stone in the center.

Dolly Parton x Kendra Scott Patchwork Lee Gold Drop Earrings

$98

Like the other pieces in this collection, these earrings are a patchwork design, but in muted tones. The hardware is gold and slightly resembles a mirror in shape.

Dolly Parton x Kendra Scott Patchwork Elisa Vintage Silver Short Pendant Necklace

This is yet another patchwork style that kind of reminds us of a stained-glass window. The hardware is silver in a vintage, almost tarnished style that makes this piece look well-loved.
